propositions: The portable claim example must omit --assignee and rely on ticket.default_assignee or unassigned behavior instead of requiring manual assignee specification
Template guidance must explain assignee behavior when ticket.default_assignee is configured versus when it is empty, without assuming Jira usage
Explicit assignee overrides with email or accountId are only required when reconciling with Jira and only when an override is intended
The link inventory must include caused_by and plan review guidance must order prerequisite review before dependent review
The generated region in templates/AGENTS.md must byte-synchronize with templates/rebar-usage.md through the established template ownership mechanism
Repository-specific Gerrit workflow guidance must be excluded from the portable template
